messages:
maria: Quick follow-up thread from the postmortem meeting. We need to lock owners for: public status wording, customer RCA distribution process, and remediation deadlines. Short replies please so I can update the tracker.
cheng: I'll take the statuscopy. Ops wants 'service impact' wording; legal prefers quantified language. I'll draft two options and ping.
alex (legal): Prefer measurable language where we can (percent, region, window). For the RCA we should publish a high-level summary publicly and offer a redacted technical RCA via secure link to affected customers. No internal IP, creds, or customer PII in public docs.
sam: SRE suggestion for public status (one-liner we can use):
```
Between 09:10-09:40 UTC we observed reduced inference throughput affecting approximately 10% of requests in eu-west. Autoscaling and cache recovery restored normal service.
```
Recommend 'reduced throughput' phrase.
nina: Support already received multiple enterprise requests for an RCA and timeline. Proposed flow: post public summary, then outreach to affected accounts with private RCAs + timeline. We'll gate with account verification or NDAs if needed.
maria: Who owns the gated RCA outreach? Need a single owner to coordinate legal, support, and eng.
nina: I can coordinate outreach and customer templates. Owner: @nina. ETA: draft email + secure link flow by Fri EOD.
cheng: Statuscopy owner: @cheng. ETA: initial two variants by today EOD, final push after signoff within 24h.
alex (legal): I'll produce a 1-page redaction checklist and signoff rubric for the private RCAs. Deliver by tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: Action created: PM-472 "Status copy variants" assigned to cheng, due 2026-03-25.
sam: On remediation timelines: SRE proposes these items
- Short term: tweak autoscaler cooldown (owner: sam) 
- Medium term: implement warmup cache for pool scale-ups (owner: eng-runtime)
- Long term: revisit scaling algorithm and add pre-warm steps (owner: platform eng)
I can take the short-term item.
maria: Please add those to the postmortem tracker with concrete due dates. I will not accept vague deadlines.
sam: Short term due in 3 business days. I'll put an exact date on tracker.
alex (legal): Public messaging should avoid calling this a "recurring outage". Suggest wording: "we are investigating a pattern related to cache and autoscaling behavior and will include mitigations in follow-up communications."
cheng: Noted. I'll include two phrasings: one generic and one with the phrase above for legal signoff.
nina: Also drafting the private-RCA template + recommended attachments (logs, timeline, mitigations). Will share to legal+cheng for signoff by Friday.
maria: Recap (please confirm with emoji):
- Statuspage copy: cheng 447 (draft EOD, push within 24h after signoff)
- Gated customer RCA outreach & email: nina 447 (draft by Fri EOD)
- Legal redaction checklist: alex (legal) 447 (by tomorrow AM)
- SRE short-term remediation (autoscaler cooldown): sam 447 (due in 3 business days)
I'll update tracker and mark items In Progress if no objections.
support-bot: Customer tickets flagged: #C-9812, #C-9821, #C-9827 have requested RCAs. Assigned to nina.
maria: If anyone can't meet these timelines please call out now. Otherwise I'll proceed to close action assignment. :white_check_mark:
